# relaybot

> Dispatch Codex (Claude Code planned) from a chat bot or personal agent such as Grok Bot: remote-control local Codex on your own computer, get a webhook callback when the coding agent finishes, fails, or needs approval, and resume the same Codex session afterwards. Runs show up in the Codex desktop app under the matching project.

The personal agent keeps the context and writes the full prompt; the user picks the coding agent explicitly; tasks use the user's Codex plan quota; sessions are managed for them.
